alt: 有人在池邊清洗沾漆的刷子，泥水意外流入池中，旁邊照料魚池的孩子擔心地看著受驚散開的小魚。
scene_prompt: Modern community pond scene: a careless person spills a bucket of muddy water while trying to wash paint from a large brush at the edge; nearby small fish scatter into cloudy water, while a child tending the pond looks concerned. Show the fish affected by an unrelated person's action, gentle and safe, no injury. Natural anatomy, realistic water and bucket contact.
